data.description:
Register the two new files in .test-index and confirm executable bits are set.

Steps:
1. Verify plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh has executable bit (chmod +x if missing)
2. Verify tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh has executable bit (chmod +x if missing)
3. Add entry to .test-index:
   plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh:tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh
4. Confirm no duplicate entries or formatting issues in .test-index (run tests/scripts/test-no-dup-test-index.sh if it exists, else inspect manually)
5. Run the test suite for the new script one time to confirm all 8 tests pass (targeted run only — do not run the full suite)

Acceptance: .test-index contains the mapping, both files are executable, all 8 tests in test-verify-session-provenance.sh pass.

Testing mode: UPDATE
data.title: UPDATE: register verify-session-provenance.sh in .test-index and set executable bit
